# spacetime

Exploring the right balance between autonomous agents & human architectural review.

🚧 **WIP**

# APM package manifest — producer package for sharing agent skills.
# Consumers install with: apm install juspay/spacetime
# Docs: https://microsoft.github.io/apm/producer/
name: spacetime
version: 1.0.0
description: >-
  Skills exploring the right balance between autonomous agents and
  human architectural review.
author: Juspay
license: MIT
repository: https://github.com/juspay/spacetime
keywords:
  - skills
  - agents
  - architecture
  - review

# Ship local primitives from .apm/ (skills, prompts, agents, …).
# Required explicit consent for pack/install of package content.
includes: auto

# No external agent deps yet — this repo authors and exports skills.
dependencies:
  apm: []
  mcp: []

scripts: {}
